description.value: Spirit Garden is a free-access community garden in Victoria managed by the City. Located on Kings Road, it offers a peaceful green-space stop for touring cyclists passing through the neighbourhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Spirit Garden as a free-admission community garden (fee=no, access=yes, garden:type=community) at 1782 Kings Road, Victoria. The website content from victoria.ca is almost entirely navigation menus with no substantive description of the garden itself and no mention of amenities such as bike parking, water, or washrooms. Without specific evidence for any amenities, nearly all checklist items must be null.
concerns: Website page is mostly navigation menus with no substantive content about the garden itself; amenities could not be verified.
Community garden may be primarily a plot-based growing space rather than a visitor-oriented attraction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A free community garden could be a pleasant stop for touring cyclists, but the website provided almost no descriptive content and none of the required criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) could be confirmed. Manual verification of on-site amenities is needed before including.

wow_evidence: Free city community garden; thin record.
blurb: Free community garden on Kings Road.
